Volkswagen Golf production history

Updated 2026-08-18. The Volkswagen Golf has been produced since 1974. Generations: Mk1 1974-1983, Mk2 1983-1991, Mk3 1991-1997, Mk4 1997-2003, Mk5 2003-2008, Mk6 2008-2012, Mk7 2012-2019, Mk8 since 2019 with a 2024 facelift.
